default_instruct: Read in a clear, engaging audiobook narration style.

scene_instructions.dialogue: Speak naturally as if in conversation, with appropriate emotion and character voice.
scene_instructions.action: Read with energy, pace, and urgency to convey the excitement.
scene_instructions.reflection: Read slowly and thoughtfully with a contemplative, introspective tone.
scene_instructions.narration: Read in a clear, engaging audiobook narration style.
scene_instructions.description: Read descriptively, painting the scene with your voice.
scene_instructions.technical: Read clearly and precisely, ensuring comprehension.
scene_instructions.emotional: Read with feeling, conveying the emotional weight of the passage.

emotion_modifiers.sad: with sadness and a somber, melancholy tone
emotion_modifiers.fearful: with tension and anxiety, as if something threatening looms
emotion_modifiers.calm: in a calm, steady, reassuring manner
emotion_modifiers.mysterious: with an air of mystery and intrigue

character_voice_hints.child: as a child with youthful energy
